error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code.
key_rule: one control per key; the last active (non-comment) line whose first token is the key wins, as shadow-utils reads login.defs; the value is the next token, surrounding double quotes removed
line_rule: lines are split on LF; one trailing CR per line is dropped; separators are only space and tab; any other control character (below 0x20 except tab, 0x7f) or other whitespace character anywhere in a line, comments included, is ERROR login-defs:invalid-line; APPLY parses by the same rule and refuses without writing
scope_rule: only /etc/login.defs is read; ageing fields of existing /etc/shadow entries are not inspected (user decision 26.09.2026: chage is an administrator decision)
source_rule: fstec-configuration-2026 1.1 table 2 recommends PASS_MAX_DAYS 90, PASS_MIN_DAYS 1-7, PASS_WARN_AGE 7-14, ENCRYPT_METHOD SHA512 or YESCRYPT; values by user decision 26.09.2026; PASS_MIN_LEN is not controlled (not honoured by all distributions; password length is the pam_pwquality step); HOME_MODE eq 0700 — fstec-linux-2022 2.3.11 (SRC-0015, control FSTEC-LINUX-2022-2.3.11-HOME-MODE), user decision 26.09.2026
value_rule: VALUE is the effective token or <absent>; eq compares decimal integers; one-of matches one of the |-separated tokens exactly (case-sensitive); an absent key is FAIL; a key line without a value, a missing, non-regular, unreadable, NUL-containing or non-UTF-8 file is ERROR
